facts.fact: Jurist Abdou Malam Garba told Le Sahel that Niger has no AI-specific framework but Law 2022-59 of 16 December 2022 on personal data applies to AI and obliges AI developers and service providers operating in Niger to declare to the HAPDP.
Per the same jurist, the HAPDP is the body before which AI developers, makers and service providers operating in Niger must file a declaration under Law 2022-59.
